title: At Palace tree lighting, Kris Aquino shares candid take on Marcos policies
summary: Queen of All Media Kris Aquino shared her candid take on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s foreign and domestic policies during Malacañang Palace’s annual Christmas tree lighting ceremony on Saturday.
